about.title: About EcoTrack V1
about.subtitle: Track your carbon footprint, build sustainable habits, and create a greener future.
about.description: EcoTrack helps people understand their environmental impact through carbon footprint calculations, insightful analytics, and easy-to-read reports. Our goal is to encourage sustainable living by turning data into meaningful action.
about.profiledescription: Track your progress and eco rank.
about.developerdescription: EcoTrack is a full-stack web application developed as a portfolio project to demonstrate modern web development, data visualization, and environmental awareness using React, Express, Node.js, MySQL, and Tailwind CSS.
